{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Tex-Mex cuisine|Tex-Mex Cuisine]]

Why do they call them '''sliders'''? Probably because they slide down so fast!

== Ingredients ==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) 80/20-ratio [[Cookbook:Beef#Chuck|ground chuck]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Cumin|cumin]]
* ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]
* ½ tsp kosher [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ tsp freshly ground black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Chipotle Pepper|chipotle powder]]
* 4 thin slices [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|Monterey Jack]] [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]]
* 16 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. 1-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] buns, split in half and toasted
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]

== Procedure ==
#Preheat an electric [[Cookbook:Griddle|griddle]] to 350[[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|°F]].
#Combine seasonings. Set aside.
#Place meat out on a [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|sheet pan]] and cover with [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|plastic wrap]]. Roll out with a rolling pin until meat fills pan.
#Remove entire sheet of parchment, including meat, from pan. Remove meat and cut into 16 equal patties with a pizza cutter.
#Sprinkle both sides of each patty with seasoning mixture. Cook on preheated griddle 1 minute per side, putting cheese on cooked side after flipping.
#Meanwhile, spread butter on each bun. Place a patty in each bun and close. Serve warm with desired condiments.
